w: The original Pea Soup Andersen's opened in Buellton in 1924, spawning a chain of highway diners across California. Only the 1976 Santa Nella branch still trades today, but the name endures for its pea soup, home-style meals, an attached bakery, gift shop and hotel, and a line of canned soups.
s: Roadside pea soup diner chain born in Buellton, 1924
_facts: Original location opened in Buellton in 1924
Santa Nella location opened 1976, now the only one still open
Sells a line of canned soups under its own brand
Site includes bakery, gift shop and an associated hotel

w: Founded September 17, 1804 by Father Estevan Tapis as a midpoint between the missions at Santa Barbara and La Purisima, easing overcrowding there and serving Native people north of the Coast Range. Alta California's first school opened here. Now a National Historic Landmark, it endures as parish church and museum.
s: Founded 1804 to ease crowding at two nearby missions
_facts: Founded September 17, 1804 by Father Estevan Tapis
Sited midway between Mission Santa Barbara and Mission La Purisima Concepcion
Housed Alta California's first learning institution
National Historic Landmark; still functions as parish church and museum
